# ~/.config/appzones/zones.toml: a first configuration that works on any host
# with appzones installed. No binds, no nix-ld: add those when you need them
# (examples/zones.toml shows every key; reference: docs/configuration/reference.md).
version = 1

[zones.daily]                  # messengers, personal browsing
colour  = "#a6e3a1"
devices = ["gpu", "audio"]

[zones.untrusted]              # links and files you do not trust
colour  = "#f38ba8"
dns     = "public"
links   = "zone"
devices = ["gpu"]

[apps.firefox]
command = ["firefox"]
zones   = ["daily", "untrusted"]
args    = { untrusted = ["--private-window"] }

# ~/.config/appzones/zones.toml: an example with every key (reference:
# docs/configuration/reference.md).
# Edited by hand. `appzones check` validates it. Changes apply at the next
# `appzones restart <zone>`; `appzones run` warns when a running zone is stale, and
# `appzones run --restart` restarts a zone with no app in it.
# Each zone starts with a fresh home in ~/.local/share/appzones/<zone>/home: no
# app data moves in from the host, host apps stay as they are.
version = 1
requires = 6                   # the zones release this file needs (`appzones check` prints its own); an older
                               # `appzones` then says "update appzones" instead of "unknown key"

[defaults]                     # every zone starts from these; a zone overrides any key
network     = "internet"       # none | internet | host
netbird     = false            # with network = "internet": also reach the NetBird mesh (the NetBird interface's network, never the host itself)
dns         = "host"           # host (the host's resolver: its ad blocking and internal names) | public (1.1.1.1, then 1.0.0.1)
links       = "portal"         # where clicked links open: portal (host default browser) | zone (this zone's browser) | "zone:NAME"
keyring     = "basic"          # basic (browsers' fixed-key store) | zone (own keyring daemon inside the zone; not built yet)
devices     = ["gpu"]          # any of: gpu audio mic camera screencast usb   (mic = audio for now)
camera      = "portal"         # portal | device   (only with "camera" in devices)
usb         = []               # with "usb" in devices: ["vvvv"] or ["vvvv:pppp"]; matching devices bound at zone start
wayland     = "zone"           # zone (own security context) | none | host (the host's socket, for GNOME: no security context)
x11         = "none"           # none | own (xwayland-satellite inside the zone; not built yet)
clipboard   = "both"           # the only value for now
autostart   = false            # start the zone at login
autostart_apps = []            # app ids started after the zone starts
userns      = true             # nested user namespaces (browser/Electron sandboxes)
machine_id  = "zone"           # zone (own, random, kept) | host
theme       = true             # copy gtk/qt/fonts/cursor config in at each start
packages    = []               # extra nixpkgs attributes on PATH, built at zone start
env         = {}               # extra environment (names checked against the never-list)
binds       = []               # { path = "~/Downloads", mode = "rw" | "ro" }; same path inside
dbus        = { talk = [], own = [] }   # host bus proxy: added to the safe default set; never-list refused
bus         = "host"           # bus for commands not in [apps]: host (proxy: portals, tray) | zone (the zone's own bus) | none
nix_ld      = false            # true: generic Linux binaries (downloaded CLIs) run, through the host's nix-ld
tmp         = "ram"            # ram (fresh tmpfs each start) | disk (~/.local/share/appzones/<zone>/tmp, kept; unused 14 days: removed)
home        = ""               # default ~/.local/share/appzones/<zone>/home
force_host  = false            # allow network = "host" and wayland = "host" in the zone named untrusted
supervisor  = "auto"           # who starts the zone: auto ($APPZONES_SUPERVISOR, else systemd when its unit is installed, else appzones) | systemd | spawn
start_timeout = "30s"          # the limit for each step of the start (building packages has none)
linger      = ""               # "" (the zone stays until stopped) | e.g. "10m": end the zone after that long with no app running

# ── zones ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[zones.daily]                  # messengers, personal browsing, media
colour    = "#a6e3a1"          # green
devices   = ["gpu", "audio", "mic", "screencast"]
binds     = [
  { path = "~/Downloads", mode = "rw" },
  { path = "~/Pictures",  mode = "ro" },
]

[zones.work]                   # work browser profile, Slack, work chat
colour    = "#89b4fa"          # blue
netbird   = true               # internal tools on the mesh (never the host itself)
links     = "zone"             # links clicked here open in this zone's browser
devices   = ["gpu", "audio", "mic", "screencast"]
packages  = ["slack"]
nix_ld    = true               # prebuilt Linux binaries (agent CLIs, release downloads) run here
tmp       = "disk"             # /tmp and /var/tmp kept across restarts, at ~/.local/share/appzones/work/{tmp,var-tmp}
# devices = ["gpu", "audio", "mic", "screencast", "usb"]
# usb     = ["abcd"]           # only these USB devices (by vendor id); after a replug: appzones restart work

[zones.untrusted]              # links and files you do not trust, one-off apps
colour    = "#f38ba8"          # red
dns       = "public"           # internal names unknown, no ad blocking
links     = "zone"
devices   = ["gpu"]            # no sound, no mic, no camera, no screen
binds     = []                 # nothing from your home; files come in through the file chooser
nix_ld    = false              # no prebuilt foreign binaries here

# ── apps: launcher entries "Name (zone)"; host entries are never hidden ──
# Firefox's "already running" remote: each zone's Firefox gets its own D-Bus
# name (org.mozilla.firefox_zone_<zone>.*) without any setting here, so a
# second launch opens in the same zone's Firefox, never another zone's.
[apps.firefox]
command = ["firefox"]
desktop = "firefox.desktop"    # name and icon taken from this entry
zones   = ["daily", "work", "untrusted"]
args    = { untrusted = ["--private-window"] }

[apps.chromium]
command = ["chromium"]
desktop = "chromium-browser.desktop"
zones   = ["work", "untrusted"]

[apps.telegram]
command = ["Telegram"]
desktop = "org.telegram.desktop.desktop"
zones   = ["daily"]

[apps.vesktop]
command = ["vesktop"]
desktop = "vesktop.desktop"
zones   = ["daily"]

[apps.discord]
command = ["discord"]
desktop = "discord.desktop"
zones   = ["daily"]

[apps.slack]
command = ["slack"]
zones   = ["work"]

[apps.code]
command = ["code"]
desktop = "code.desktop"
zones   = ["work"]

[apps.kitty]
command = ["kitty"]
desktop = "kitty.desktop"
zones   = ["daily", "work", "untrusted"]

[apps.mpv]
command = ["mpv", "--player-operation-mode=pseudo-gui"]
desktop = "mpv.desktop"
zones   = ["daily", "untrusted"]

# Single-instance apps own a bus name (org.xfce.Thunar): on the host bus a
# zone never may, so they get the zone's own bus (no portals there; the
# second launch hands over to the first). `appzones run daily -- thunar` uses it too.
[apps.thunar]
command = ["thunar"]
desktop = "thunar.desktop"
zones   = ["daily", "work", "untrusted"]
bus     = "zone"
